author: mostafa_gawad (JUMP ANIMATION)

author: dragon_trappers_lodge
title: Hiring Concept Artist for Fantasy Miniatures
content:
WE'RE HIRING: CONCEPT ARTIST! ⚔️

The position will entail creating 2d concept art for 3d printable fantasy miniatures. Concepts will need to be refined line art drawings. No rendering, color, or value work required. Typically no turnarounds required, occasional weapon or prop details may be needed. Often there will be multiple poses which will require loose sketches.

👉We pay $100/concept with more complex detailed creatures granting more pay on a case by case basis. If you enjoy designing characters and monsters but don't like spending weeks on the same design then this is for you. You will be able to work on many designs and someone who works quick will thrive in this role. The quicker you work the more we can send you.

Creativity is extremely valuable and there is lots of room for creative freedom. People who don't work quickly, or are unable to take direction and revisions won't do well in this position.

The following skill sets are required.
✔️in depth understanding of human anatomy
✔️in depth understanding of creature and animal anatomy
✔️great drawing and sketching skills
✔️understanding of dynamic posing

⚠️ IMPORTANT — PLEASE READ:
All applications must be submitted through our official BambooHR hiring page, linked in our bio.

We do not accept applications, review portfolios, answer hiring questions, or conduct any part of the recruitment process through Instagram, including DMs and comments.

Please review the full job description and follow the application instructions provided there.

Good luck!

author: egofilm_studio
title: Hiring Lead Illustrator and Background Illustrator
content:
🎬 EGoFILM poszukuje Lead Ilustratora oraz Background Ilustratora!

Do nowego projektu serialu animowanego szukamy osoby, która będzie odpowiedzialna między innymi za:
• projektowanie i rozwijanie lokacji oraz backgroundów (background ilustrator),
• współtworzenie warstwy wizualnej serialu (lead ilustrator),
• dbanie o spójność stylistyczną ilustracji (lead ilustrator),
• współpracę z Art Directorem, reżyserami oraz zespołem ilustratorów (lead ilustrator).

Jeśli masz doświadczenie w pracy przy projektach animowanych, prześlij swoje portfolio na:
📩 rekrutacja@egofilm.pl

Do zobaczenia!

(English: EGoFILM is looking for a Lead Illustrator and Background Illustrator for a new animated series project. Responsibilities include designing and developing locations and backgrounds, co-creating the visual layer, ensuring stylistic consistency, and collaborating with the Art Director, directors, and illustrator team. Send portfolio to rekrutacja@egofilm.pl)
